description: A tab of the main area (title "Feedback", or "Feedback (N)" with N the fixes waiting for your review; tooltip "The feedback on Baude, and where each stands"): left, a list of all the feedback (GitHub issues plus notes saved on this machine); right, the one selected, its note, what's been said on it, each round of its fix with before and after images, and a bar for what can be done. Baude's and Record's.
opens: a feedback issue or PR chosen in the @ list or the glossary search (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K): shown here, selected; any other issue opens on GitHub in the browser
back / forward in the tab history

parts.name: List header
parts.shows: A row at the top of the left column (240 px at least, 300 by default, a draggable divider between it and the detail): a linked pair of toggle buttons "Ongoing" (on at first) and "All"; a flat + button; a read-again button.

actions.does: Ongoing lists what is Ready for review, In Progress, Open, Filed or Waiting to upload (in that order, newest first within each); All adds Merged, Rejected, Closed and Resolved. Switching to Ongoing drops a selected finished item from the list; while finished the selected one otherwise stays listed so keys never land on another.
opens the Send Feedback dialog; the new note appears in the list as it is saved, and again a moment later when filed
reads GitHub again; the icon turns while reading

parts.name: List rows
parts.shows: Each row: the title (up to two lines, wrapped, ellipsized); beneath, a coloured status pill and a dimmed line "<Repo>#<number> · <how long ago it was last updated>" plus " · N capture(s)" when notes have captures. The location prefix (Baude#12, BaudeInternal#3) is blank for a note never filed. Status pill labels: Open, In Progress, Ready for review, Merged, Rejected, Closed, Waiting to upload (a note saved only here), Filed (filed but unreadable now), Resolved (a note with a resolution). The row's age text moves on without redrawing the list.

actions.does: selects it and shows it in the detail; the reply field is cleared. With nothing selected the first row is selected.

parts.name: List foot
parts.shows: A dimmed, ellipsized line under the list saying what was read and when: "<repo name(s)> · read HH:MM" (the repositories read from, e.g. Baude, BaudeInternal); "GitHub isn't connected: only what's saved here" when not connected; "Couldn't read it just now: <why>" (full error in the tooltip) when GitHub failed. Opened again, the last read's time is shown at once (as a relative time, with a clock tooltip) while it reads afresh.

parts.name: Detail: issue
parts.shows: Scrolling column, 980 px at most: the title large and selectable; a line with the status pill, a dimmed "<Repo>#N · from <author> · <time>" (created), an "Issue" link button (tooltip the URL) and, when it has a pull request, a "PR #N" link button; then the issue's text as markdown (images shown as links, never fetched).

actions.does: opens that page on GitHub in the browser

parts.name: Detail: thread rounds
parts.shows: Below the issue, what has been said and each round of the fix, in order: a card per round headed "In progress", "Ready for review", "Failed", "Stopped", "No change" or "Fix discarded" with a dimmed time and, if known, " · <machine>"; its text as markdown; and each picture it shows. A round still running is not drawn here (the bar says it). Other people's comments are headed by their author name.

parts.name: Before / after pictures
parts.shows: Each thing a fix shows: an optional label line, then two equal columns "Before" and "After" (dimmed captions) with the image under each, fitted to the column; while read, a spinner in a 120 px box. A missing before says "Not there before this fix"; a missing after says "None"; an unreadable file says "This image can't be read".

actions.does: opens the large image view (← and → step through this tab's images; right-click for the image menu as in the chat)

parts.name: Detail: saved note card
parts.shows: For a note kept on this machine: when it was resolved a heading "Resolved <date time>" and its resolution as markdown ("(no note)" if empty), then its screen captures two to a line, marked version when there is one. A note with no resolution and no captures has no card. A note filed as an issue shows under that issue (its captures exist only here, GitHub can't hold them); a note not filed is an item of its own.

parts.name: Action bar
parts.shows: A bar under the detail (hidden entirely when there is nothing to say or do, as on a merged item). A dimmed hint line, and a row of controls whose visibility depends on the item's status (below). While something is running a spinner shows and all buttons are greyed.

parts.name: Ask for changes
parts.shows: Only for a Ready-for-review item whose PR is this repository's own fix branch, when you can write: a text field with placeholder "Ask for changes…" and a Send button (tooltip "Say it on the issue, and fix it again"), enabled once something is typed.

actions.does: comments the text on the issue and starts another fix round; the field is cleared

parts.name: Fix here
parts.shows: Suggested-style button on an Open item (can write). Tooltip "Fix it on this machine, on branch fix/<key>".

actions.does: starts a fix round on this machine (a Claude run in a worktree, on a fix/<key> branch, opening a draft PR); the item becomes In Progress

parts.name: Merge
parts.shows: Suggested-style button on a Ready-for-review item (can write). Tooltip "Merge PR #N: every running Baude and Record updates to it".

actions.does: asks "Merge the fix for <Repo>#N?" / "PR #N goes into main, and every running Baude and Record updates itself from main." with Cancel and Merge; Merge merges the PR as a merge commit, only if it is still the commit that was read

parts.name: Discard
parts.shows: Destructive-style button on a Ready-for-review item (can write). Tooltip "Discard the fix: its PR closed, its branch deleted, the feedback still open".

actions.does: asks "Discard the fix for <Repo>#N?" / "PR #N is closed and its branch deleted. The feedback stays open." with Cancel and Discard (red); Discard closes the PR, deletes the branch and leaves the feedback open

parts.name: Reopen
parts.shows: Button on a Rejected item (can write). Tooltip "Open the issue again".

parts.name: Stop
parts.shows: Button on an In Progress item whose round is running on this machine (can write). Tooltip "Stop the fix running on this machine".

states.name: first open, reading
states.shows: The list placeholder says "Loading issues…" with nothing on the right until the first read (any saved notes appear at once)

states.name: opened again
states.shows: What was read last time and the notes saved here at once, while GitHub is read afresh in the background (every 60 s while shown, every 15 s while a round is running)

states.name: nothing ongoing
states.shows: Empty list placeholder "Nothing ongoing" after a read

states.name: GitHub not connected, nothing saved
states.shows: Right pane: a status page, title "GitHub isn't connected", text "Feedback lives on GitHub. Sign the gh CLI in (gh auth login) on a checkout of Baude from GitHub, and it shows here." Foot: "GitHub isn't connected: only what's saved here". Saved notes, if any, still list.

states.name: couldn't read, nothing known
states.shows: Status page titled "Couldn't read the feedback" with the error as its text

states.name: read-only (no write access)
states.shows: No Fix here, Merge, Discard, Reopen, Stop or reply field; for an Open or Ready item the hint is "Only people with write access to <repo> can fix or merge."

states.name: working here
states.shows: In Progress item: hint "<Repo>#N is running on <machine>" (or "... on another machine"); Stop shown when it runs on this machine

states.name: draft PR
states.shows: In Progress with no running round: hint "PR #N is a draft: in progress."

states.name: last fix failed
states.shows: Open or Ready item whose last round failed: hint "The last fix here didn't go ahead: <why>"

states.name: filed, unreadable
states.shows: A note filed as an issue that GitHub can't give now: pill Filed, hint "Filed as an issue, but it can't be read from GitHub here just now, so this is only the note saved here."

states.name: private repository
states.shows: Feedback kept on a private repository beside Baude's (BaudeInternal for Baude) is listed together with Baude's, each saying which repository it is in the "<Repo>#N" label; its fix is a PR on the public repository, titled from the reply's own "Title:" line

states.name: action running
states.shows: A spinner in the bar and every button greyed; afterwards the list is read again, and again 6 s later (a round's first comment takes a few seconds). An error from the action appears as a toast of its first line (160 characters, 10 s).

states.name: refreshing
states.shows: The refresh icon turns, in full colour, while reading

states.name: restart
states.shows: The selection, the Ongoing/All choice and the typed reply are kept across a restart

decisions.said: Changing the files of the saved issues on disk should change what Baude shows too, so Baude can be told to fix itself (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: While the Feedback tab is open, every app follows the saved feedback notes on disk (a note's files changed, a note added or removed) and redraws the list and detail from them.
